smell_validity.evidence: The three injected classes hold only a wrapped record while deriving all fragments from it; the Themes model also reads the themes storage schema and safe-mode settings and mutates selection through the themes API, behavior the themes module owns. Repo precedent (the unified plugin model already carrying behaviors) draws the boundary well, though the manifest-only class remains defensible as a plain view-model.

maintenance_impact.evidence: Theme selection rules are duplicated into a page-level class: it reads the themes storage schema, mirrors the selection API, and keeps the remove-then-revert contract, so selection changes must keep two places in agreement. Plugin card behavior is split between the unified model and a sibling formatter. Real error-proneness across boundaries, but local rather than architectural.

development_plausibility.evidence: The models carry fragments verbatim from the cards, preserving quirks like the selectAndApply error log, and placement mirrors the existing unified-plugin-model and shared-card idioms. The motivation, normalizing three remaining list surfaces, fits the visible convergence. One artificial tell: three structurally identical classes land together, slightly regular for natural evolution.

prompt_accuracy.evidence: The prompt pins the landing rule (data-owning surfaces or access layer), lists every affected surface including the sheet header, and itemizes preserved behavior: radio semantics, apply/clear error path, toasts, confirmation flow, fallbacks, subscriptions staying in components, and both installed-plugin kinds keeping full behavior. That decisively blocks wrong direction, partial cleanup and irrelevant redesign while leaving placement choices open.

semantic_diversity.evidence: Three purposes exist: theme selection and destructive-flow handling with the view removal callback and revert ordering; plugin roster fragments feeding both the card and the store-driven user fetch on a dual-kind model; static manifest display text. The first two need genuinely different decisions, while the manifest relocation is placement-only, so not every purpose carries its own decision.

localization_burden.evidence: The prompt already enumerates the injected classes, their cards, the sheet header, and the data-owning landing surfaces; the diff adds no other consumers. Locating them is one direct search within the named pages plus tracing the unified model's construction sites; no cross-component combination is needed.

repair_coordination.evidence: Shared rules span clusters: the roster feeds both the list card context and the sheet's store hook, and both installed-plugin kinds must expose the relocated behavior; the theme delete flow must preserve revert ordering plus the view guard. Rewiring only one consumer or kind leaves the other surface broken, though static typing may flag part of it.

mechanical_resistance.evidence: A verbatim relocate-to-owner template cleanly fixes the manifest and plugin classes: bodies are pure derivations and consumers rewire mechanically. The theme overflow trio mixes data rules with confirmation UI and the removal callback, forcing a split decision about what moves, so one uniform rule covers roughly two of three problem locations.

behavioral_risk.evidence: A wrong relocation passes ordinary browsing: reading radio state from the record instead of the themes map diverges only when they disagree, and skipping the wasSelected revert leaves an applied theme after deletion. The store-hook and delete paths need special state to fail. No test evidence is available to establish the unchecked-path conditions required above this score.

recommendation_reason: Deterministic validation passed and every Quality dimension meets the retention threshold.
